issue.title: Installation instructions for Ubuntu outdated
issue.body:
About the main [README](https://github.com/httpie/httpie/tree/master/docs#debian-and-ubuntu) of the docs.

Since Ubuntu 21.10, the [apt-key](https://manpages.ubuntu.com/manpages/impish/en/man8/apt-key.8.html) management utility is deprecated and should not be used anymore. Therefore, the docs should be corrected. Also, they assume you are working as the superuser. I suggest adding `sudo` .
